text.zh: 很久很久以前……
text.en: Long, long ago…

text.zh: 传说，在世界的最高处，有一颗永不熄灭的星星，世人都想寻找到它。
text.en: It is said that at the top of the world burns a star that never goes out. Everyone wants to find it.

text.zh: 小骑士，系紧行囊，你该出发了。
text.en: Little knight, tighten your pack. It is time to go.

text.zh: WASD 移动，空格跳跃。
text.en: WASD to move, Space to jump.

text.zh: 路这么黑，带着这盏灯走吧。
text.en: The road is dark. Take this lantern with you.

text.zh: 获得能力点：勇气
text.en: Ability gained: Courage

text.zh: 消耗 1 点星光，跃起约 3 米高。
text.en: Spend 1 Star Energy to leap about 3 meters high.

text.zh: 前面没路了？骑士，别担心，世上原本就没有路……
text.en: No more road ahead? Don't worry, knight. There never was a road…

text.zh: 获得能力点：智慧
text.en: Ability gained: Wisdom

text.zh: 消耗 1 点星光，点亮半径 12 米内的隐藏方块或道路。
text.en: Spend 1 Star Energy to reveal hidden blocks within 12 meters.

text.zh: 你是去找星星的？骑士，别想了，我什么也没找到，才折返至此。
text.en: You're looking for the star? Don't bother, knight. I found nothing, and turned back.

text.zh: 获得能力点：耐心
text.en: Ability gained: Patience

text.zh: 消耗 1 点星光，让脚下的方块上升 2 米。
text.en: Spend 1 Star Energy to raise the block under your feet by 2 meters.

text.zh: 够不着的地方，不如就自己创造一个落脚点。
text.en: If you can't reach it, make your own footing.

text.zh: 获得能力点：希望
text.en: Ability gained: Hope

text.zh: 消耗 2 点星光，在前方生成一块临时平台（存在 10 秒，最后 2 秒闪烁）。
text.en: Spend 2 Star Energy to summon a temporary platform ahead (lasts 10 seconds, blinks for the last 2).

text.zh: 到了，这里就是世界的最高处。小骑士，前方什么也没有。或许星星只是一个传说，一个你梦中的美丽幻影，又或许……
text.en: You've arrived. This is the highest place in the world. Little knight, there is nothing ahead. Perhaps the star was only a legend—a beautiful dream in your sleep. Or perhaps…

text.zh: 再跳一步
text.en: One more jump.

text.zh: 你找到那颗永不熄灭的星星了吗？
text.en: Did you find the star that never goes out?

text.zh: 点击任意键继续
text.en: Press any key to continue.

text.zh: 传说，在世界最高处，有一颗永不熄灭的星星。
text.en: It is said that at the top of the world burns a star that never goes out.

text.zh: 星光黯淡了……
text.en: The starlight fades…

text.zh: 风将你带回了曾经走过的路。
text.en: The wind carries you back to the path you walked.
